Title: Quayside API documentation

# Quayside API documentation

The Quayside API gives harbour operators programmatic access to berth planning, vessel
data and tide windows. The current version is 3; version 2 was retired on 30 June 2026.

## Guides

- Authentication: https://docs.quayside.example/v3/authentication
- Errors: https://docs.quayside.example/v3/errors
- Rate limits: https://docs.quayside.example/v3/rate-limits
- SDKs and tools: https://docs.quayside.example/sdks

## Reference (v3)

- List berth slots: https://docs.quayside.example/v3/reference/berth-slots
- Look up a vessel: https://docs.quayside.example/v3/reference/vessels
- Tide windows: https://docs.quayside.example/v3/reference/tide-windows

## Legacy

- Version 2 berth schedule (retired): https://docs.quayside.example/v2/reference/berth-schedule

The API's base URL is `https://api.quayside.example`; the sandbox's is
`https://sandbox.quayside.example`.
